scope: Preregistered serial 2x2 factorial (3 repetitions per arm) plus separately registered 12-pair cache replay and two V2 complete-generation attempts. Failures are retained.

primary_protocol.protocol: Serial fresh full pipelines in three predeclared randomized rotating blocks; no model-generating run overlaps. Same exact compiler/input/acceptance/environment/dependency snapshot; only event context and prefix flags differ. No failed attempt is repaired/replaced or excluded. Timeouts included as failures. All gates plus unchanged fixed14 and production14 required.
primary_protocol.speed_estimand: Generation+final build wall seconds and complete-attempt wall seconds. Report ALL attempts, success-conditional summaries separately, failure-inclusive time and tokens per accepted application; never rank early failures as faster success. Block paired factorial effects with uncertainty; generation trajectory variance remains part of full pipeline behavior.
primary_protocol.cache_policy: Provider best-effort caches cannot be reset or pinned; blocked interleaving reduces order bias, does not guarantee cold/warm matching. Count full pipeline SDK cache hit/miss by tokens, not average percentages. No automatic extra warm-up model calls.
primary_protocol.completion: All declared attempts terminal, including failed ones; compute aggregate/ablation/uncertainty and cache diagnosis. No fixed threshold for reliability/speed is assumed. Three per arm provides exploratory evidence, not a high-confidence success-rate guarantee.

cache_v2.decision: Keep ARC_CACHE_PREFIX_V2 disabled: local cache mechanism improves, but 0/2 full generations accepted and no successful full-pipeline cache/speed benefit established. No automatic promotion.
cache_v2.comparison_limits: V2 attempts follow primary campaign with a different candidate revision; no strict V2 speed-effect inference. Both failures counted, including an early Stage10 failure before V2 acts.

cache_replay.elapsed_scope: Replay elapsed wraps invoke and logging; SDK elapsed measures the inner request. Outer must be >= inner; not falsely required to equal. Per-arm sums reproduce replay outer measurements.
cache_replay.limits: Contract structure validation is not application acceptance. Tokenizer boundary effects may change prompt token counts despite identical JSON values. No causal full-pipeline speed inference.

primary.scope: Raw SDK response usage/hash, exact source/input/assertion bytes, configurations, schedule and serial timestamp order, gate and acceptance summaries against raw Playwright stats. Unclosed spans retained as unknown. Does not certify provider routing, billing or external host isolation.

cache_view_provenance.purpose: Read-only derived audit view so the existing factorial auditor checks actual follow-up runs. Original follow-up protocol and results are unchanged.
cache_view_provenance.derivation: Exact follow-up protocol plus compiler_source from the registered detached candidate and dependency hash/entry count from the original primary snapshot. runs/dependencies symlink original evidence; no copied or edited results.
cache_view_provenance.checks: Candidate revision, full fixed-count schedule, frozen files and sole V2 config difference checked before constructing view.

conclusions.speed: No stable speedup established. No within-block successful 00/11 pair; all-attempt bootstrap is exploratory and includes early failures.
conclusions.ablation: Context mean additive total-token effect -304555.7 (exploratory interval crosses zero); prefix +224466.3 (crosses zero). No precise causal ranking from n3 and frequent failures.
conclusions.cache: V2 local replay improves cache reuse; complete attempts 0/2, so keep disabled. Full ratio alone is inflated by repair repetition and is insufficient.
conclusions.cost_scope: Returned SDK usage only, HTTP mirrors excluded. No unknown-usage requests in these trials; token counts are not a provider invoice.
conclusions.follow_up: Fix cross-API session composition, design predicate admission and generated action/oracle contradictions before a new optimization/reliability campaign. Those compiler fixes are outside this completed measurement campaign.
